Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: Misidentified the landmark on the August 2021 Vogue cover as the White House based on superficial search results. The cover features the Washington Monument behind trees, not the White House, leading to using the White House’s height (70 ft → 23 yards) instead of the Washington Monument’s height (~555 ft → ~185 yards).
